description: This file contains a PHP unit test class 'PerformanceTrackerDaoTest' that tests the 'PerformanceTrackerDao' class within the OrangeHRM system's Performance module. It specifically tests methods related to performance tracker persistence, reviewer's role validation, and updates to performance tracker entities.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case that verifies the behavior of PerformanceTrackerDao methods within the OrangeHRM performance module.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the PerformanceTrackerDao instance and populates fixture data before each test.

methods.name: testSavePerformanceTrackerWithTransactionException
methods.description: Tests that an exception during 'persist' leads to a TransactionException being thrown.

methods.name: testIsTrackerReviewerWithNullEmpNumber
methods.description: Verifies that 'isTrackerReviewer' returns false when given a null employee number.

methods.name: testUpdatePerformanceTrackerWithEmptyReviewerArray
methods.description: Checks that updating a performance tracker with an empty reviewer array returns the original entity.
